title: SeaweedFS before 4.42 File Existence Disclosure via VolumeServer.FetchAndWriteNeedle (CVE-2026-129852)
description: SeaweedFS versions prior to 4.42 contain an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to probe local files on the host. By sending specially crafted gRPC FetchAndWriteNeedle requests with a filesystem path in the gcs_google_application_credentials parameter, attackers can distinguish file existence, readability, and partial content characteristics based on error messages. This vulnerability is fixed in version 4.42.0.
